parameters.name: href
parameters.description: - The URL of the favicon to set.

properties.name: preserveFaviconOnUnmount
properties.description:
Whether to keep the favicon after unmounting the component (default is `true`).
If `false`, the favicon will revert to what it was before this hook mounted.

properties.name: type
properties.description: The MIME type of the favicon (default is `image/x-icon`).
